note: Inyo County campground on 80-acre Diaz Lake, 3 mi south of Lone Pine off US-395. The sites line the lake's west shore; the Waucoba (70-85) and Maturango (86-99) stretch sits on open grass a short walk from the reed-fringed shore. ATV trails start outside the back gate (no riding inside the campground). Motorized boating mid-May through October. --Claude
